title: 第5章 天神下凡第6章 一万块网贷
slug: 赵老驴和杏花村的女人们
content_zh:
赵大柱一脸为难的说道：“彩霞妹子，我不是要赖你的账，问题是咱俩约定好了半年之内给你还钱，我现在都还没准备好呢，你这时候跟我要，我拿什么给你还钱？”
“可我也等钱用啊……”王彩霞带着一丝哭腔，急的眼圈都红了。
赵大柱叹气道：“我现在是真的没办法，要不你看我家里什么东西值钱，你就拿去卖了。”
赵大柱都把话说这份上了，王彩霞自然无计可施，她总不能真的跑到赵大柱屋里拿东西。
叹了口气，王彩霞就转身离开。
而她刚走，赵大柱就急急忙忙的回到客厅，并把门关上。
“咱们继续？”赵大柱问道。
“问我干什么，你想继续，就……就继续呗……”
李玉娇羞羞答答的说道，脸红害羞的样子就像是一株还没有完全盛开的山茶花。
赵大柱忍不住咽了一口唾沫，便急不可耐的上前。
他抬起两只手伸了过去，想要解开李玉娇衣服领口的纽扣。
哪知道一阵女人的凄厉哭喊声，突然从隔壁王彩霞家里传来。
而且那分明就是王彩霞的声音！
“这还有完没完了？”李玉娇怒道。
赵大柱也是气的在心里骂娘，但他没有多说什么，急急忙忙的朝着外面跑去。
王彩霞也是个苦命女人，身为寡妇无依无靠，生活已经很困难了，还得供女儿上学，所以赵大柱是真的不希望她出事。
而赵大柱刚刚跑到王彩霞家门口，就看到几个地痞无赖趾高气昂的站在王彩霞家院子里。
甚至还有人闯进王彩霞的屋里往外搬东西！
而王彩霞此刻正瘫坐在地，披头散发哭的喘不上气。
“你们住手……别拿我家东西……”

“我没说不交钱啊……再给我点时间缓缓……”
“王建国呢……那个狗东西在哪？他不出面，让你们来我家抢东西是吧，他是不是人……”
王彩霞又哭又喊，满脸都是眼泪。
听到动静的杏花村村民，从各个方向而来，拥挤在院门口朝里张望。
看到这一幕，他们便指指点点，咒骂王建国。
但他们也只能通过这种方式来表达对王彩霞这个寡妇的同情，真让他们上前帮忙，他们自然是不肯的。
赵大柱却看不下去了，只稍稍迟疑了一下就攥着拳头大步走去，并呵斥道：“都给我住手！你们这帮大老爷们竟然欺负一个寡妇，要不要脸！”
院门口那些村民顿时全都惊呆了。
他们做梦都想不到，赵大柱竟然敢过去帮忙。
在他们的眼里，赵大柱就是一个老实巴交的老光棍，不管见了谁都和和气气。
说好听点，这叫随和。
说难听点，那就一个字——怂！
可现在，这么一个怂到家的糟老头，居然硬气起来了。
content_en:
Zhao Dazhu said with an embarrassed look: "Sister Caixia, I don't want to take your debt. The problem is that we have agreed to pay you back within half a year. I'm not ready yet. If you ask me for it now, what can I give you to pay you back?"
"But I'm also waiting for the money..." Wang Caixia said with a hint of crying, her eyes red with anxiety.
Zhao Dazhu sighed and said: "I really have no choice now. Otherwise, if you see what is valuable in my house, you can sell it."
Zhao Dazhu had already said this, so naturally Wang Caixia had nothing to do. She couldn't really go to Zhao Dazhu's house to get something.
After sighing, Wang Caixia turned and left.
As soon as she left, Zhao Dazhu hurried back to the living room and closed the door.
"Shall we continue?" Zhao Dazhu asked.
"Ask me what I'm doing. If you want to continue, just...just continue..."
Li Yu said shyly, blushing and shy like a camellia that had not fully bloomed.
Zhao Dazhu couldn't help but swallowed, and stepped forward impatiently.
He raised his hands and reached over, trying to unbutton the collar of Li Yujiao's clothes.
Unexpectedly, a woman's shrill cries suddenly came from Wang Caixia's house next door.
And that was clearly Wang Caixia’s voice!
"Is this over yet?" Li Yujiao asked angrily.
Zhao Dazhu was also angry and cursed in his heart, but he didn't say anything more and hurriedly ran outside.
Wang Caixia is also a hard-working woman. As a widow with no one to rely on, life is already very difficult. She also has to support her daughter in school, so Zhao Dazhu really doesn't want anything to happen to her.
As soon as Zhao Dazhu ran to the door of Wang Caixia's house, he saw several ruffians standing arrogantly in Wang Caixia's yard.
Some people even broke into Wang Caixia's house and moved things out!
At this moment, Wang Caixia was slumped on the ground, her hair disheveled and crying out of breath.
"Stop it... don't take my things..."
"I didn't say I won't pay...just give me some time to calm down..."
"Where is Wang Jianguo... Where is that piece of shit? If he doesn't come forward, he will let you come to my house to grab things, right? Is he a human..."
Wang Caixia cried and shouted, her face covered with tears.
Upon hearing the commotion, villagers from Xinghua Village came from all directions, crowded at the entrance of the courtyard and looked in.
Seeing this scene, they pointed and cursed Wang Jianguo.
But they could only express their sympathy for Wang Caixia, a widow, in this way. If they were asked to come forward to help, they would naturally refuse.
Zhao Dazhu couldn't stand it any longer. He hesitated for a moment before striding away with his fists clenched and scolding: "Stop it! You guys are bullying a widow. How shameless!"
The villagers at the entrance of the courtyard were all stunned.
They never dreamed that Zhao Dazhu would dare to go and help.
In their eyes, Zhao Dazhu is an honest and honest old bachelor who is kind to everyone he meets.
To put it nicely, this is called easy-going.
To put it harshly, I would use one word - coward!
But now, such a cowardly old man has become stubborn.
